takeaways: NRG earned $4.68 adjusted vs $3.33 expected (Benzinga); revenue of $9.47 billion beat by about $230 million. Adjusted EBITDA was $2.01 billion vs $1.21 billion a year ago.
Much of the lift is the LS Power generation assets and CPower it bought and closed, which also added shares.

It reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $7.90-$9.90 and gave first 2027 guidance of $8.05-$10.05, a midpoint of $9.05 vs about $10.51 the Street had (StreetInsider). Treat the comparison with care: the 2027 range does not include the sale below.

It agreed to sell six gas plants (4.9 GW) back to LS Power for about $4 billion in cash, expected to close in Q2 2027, and plans $3 billion of buybacks across 2026-2027 plus $3 billion of debt reduction in 2027 (StockTitan summary of the release).
GAAP EPS was $2.59, well below the adjusted $4.68.
verdict: A giant beat, then a 2027 guide that came in under what Wall Street penciled in. The stock ran up 10% on Friday, so a beat-and-selloff was one real possibility. Selling gas plants to fund buybacks is the classic move. Max says watch the guide, not the beat.
